signature.name: Frame-Budget Footprint
signature.description: How much of the loader repaints each frame, how many layers it promotes, and whether it costs nothing when paused or hidden.

lesson: The loaders that ship are the ones with few animated nodes, one clock and no cuts or clips; every extra animated element or hard cut is cost a weak phone pays on every frame.

bare-wire.signature_why: Five animated SVG children repaint the whole small SVG each frame, but only 2 will-change nodes, no JS, pausable; v2 drops a node.
bare-wire.loved: Six fill-only shapes, zero-state at 0%/100%, no JS in the animation path, and the hole now closes slowly instead of rippling outward.
bare-wire.docked: Animation still lives on SVG children so the full SVG repaints, will-change on SVG nodes buys little, and the duplicate pasted SVG remains.
bare-wire.fix_note: Scar is larger and held so it reads at 120px and the heal disc is gone, but the heal rim and single-instance markup were not taken.

warm-hands.signature_why: One rotating group plus opacity shimmers: no JS, pausable, but bezier-heavy paths repaint the whole SVG through a use shadow tree and will-change on SVG groups is a no-op.
warm-hands.loved: Single 5s period for every animated property, linear sweep with matching velocity at the wrap, and one shared symbol for both sizes.
warm-hands.docked: The sweep still repaints the entire cup every frame, and v2 adds another animated node (the stream) while declining the layer split.
warm-hands.fix_note: Layer split declined as a second SVG for about one point; the repaint is disclosed honestly, so the reason mostly holds but the cost stays.

the-glitch.signature_why: v2 is five animated nodes, no clip-path and no cuts, but all are SVG children so the full SVG repaints; the 0.98 breathe repaints for nothing.
the-glitch.loved: The hard cuts and the clip-masked orange slip are gone, and the drop now fades and squashes into the ring on one 1s beat that divides 5s.
the-glitch.docked: The pointless 0.98 surface breathe still repaints every frame, and the 0.25s crema swap at the wrap can read as a drain.
the-glitch.fix_note: Opacity snap and teleport replaced by eased squash and fade, and the slip was deleted outright.
